dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped structures display sharp, jagged light-colored perimeters with high-contrast transitions to dark interior cores; prominent 'O' shapes are located along the dorsal-lateral midline.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, solid high-intensity pixel clusters interspersed between larger annuli, with a concentration of lower-intensity solid blobs in the darker ventral-lateral regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest macro-annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle on the upper flank; a secondary linear alignment of smaller blobs follows the longitudinal axis towards the posterior.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly defined, elongated linear high-contrast structures corresponding to the claws on the visible upper flipper.
